steps.text: This is the new Family screen. Everything from the old screen is still here, organized so the things you use most are on top.
The header shows who this family is and how to reach them.
The most common actions are these buttons. Less frequent ones, like printing or removing a role, are in this menu.
Instead of one long page, the information is now in tabs: Overview, Approvals, Assignments, Documents, and Timeline and Notes.
The numbers on each tab show what's inside. A colored badge means something needs your attention, like a missing requirement or notes awaiting review.
Overview shows the family members, organizations, and everything that happened in the last seven days.
For a client family, you'll see Arrangements and Case History instead of Approvals.
If you'd like to keep using the old screen for now, click your profile picture, then Beta Features.
Turn off Family Screen V2, and families open in the old screen again. Turn it back on the same way when you're ready.
If something made you switch back, tell us through the chat bubble, so we can fix it before the old screen goes away.
